notes.title: Demo Patch #1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

This patch addresses the most common issues experienced by players in the demo and adds some quality of life improvements.

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
- Added sound settings.
- Added scaling settings. The game with automatically use 150% zoom on the screens that can fit it.
- Added “Encamp” button for armies to skip their turns automatically.
- Changed army UI to make army split more obvious.

[h3]Minor Stuff[/h3]
- Changed the way of how the world map is rendered to chunk-based. Should improve performance if anyone had issues with it.
- Removed some unnecessary menus from the top bar (I'll remove the all eventually).
- Added faction tooltips, so you know who is who.
- Changed the wording on “need more districts” issue to make it more clear.
- Changed some building effects descriptions to make them more clear.
- Increases projectiles speed slightly.
